**Microsoft FY2024 gross margin (fiscal year ended June 30, 2024)**

| Item | FY2024 | FY2023 |
|---|---|---|
| Revenue | $245,122M | $211,915M |
| Cost of revenue | $74,114M | $65,863M |
| **Gross margin (gross profit)** | **$171,008M** | $146,052M |
| Gross margin % | 69.8% | 68.9% |

- Revenue and cost of revenue are taken directly from the filing: "Fiscal year ended June 30, 2024: Revenue $245,122; Cost of revenue $74,114. Fiscal year ended June 30, 2023 (prior-year comparative): Revenue $211,915; Cost of revenue $65,863." [DOC: msft_10k_fy2024.txt]
- Gross margin in dollars = $245,122M − $74,114M = **$171,008M**, an increase of $24,956M (+17.1%) versus FY2023's $146,052M.
- As a percentage of revenue, gross margin was **69.8%** in FY2024 vs. 68.9% in FY2023, roughly 85 basis points of expansion.

Comparability note: both periods are Microsoft's own June 30 fiscal years as presented in the same FY2024 10-K, so the year-over-year comparison is on a consistent basis. The dollar and percentage gross margin figures above are derived from the reported revenue and cost of revenue lines; the excerpt does not separately state a gross margin line or discuss any segment/reporting-basis changes, so no reclassification adjustments are reflected.

ANSWER: $171,008 million (≈69.8% of revenue), i.e., $245,122M revenue less $74,114M cost of revenue for FY2024
